name: praxis
description: Codifies engineering/SDLC processes — spec, plan, and more — as skills and subagents.

vcs_token.title: Version-control token (fallback only)
vcs_token.description: Leave empty unless a capability's transport is set to `api`. Preferred: an already-connected version-control MCP server, or an authenticated CLI — both need NO token here. Only set this if you configured the `api` transport for your version-control host.

ci_token.title: CI/CD token (fallback only)
ci_token.description: Leave empty unless the CI capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected CI MCP server or an authenticated CLI, which need no token here.

knowledge_token.title: Knowledge-base token (fallback only)
knowledge_token.description: Leave empty unless the knowledge capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected knowledge MCP server (or a local filesystem root), which need no token here.

artifacts_token.title: Artifacts token (fallback only)
artifacts_token.description: Leave empty unless the artifacts capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected artifacts MCP server (or a local filesystem root), which need no token here.

project_mgmt_token.title: Project-management token (fallback only)
project_mgmt_token.description: Leave empty unless the project-management capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected tracker MCP server, which needs no token here.

communication_token.title: Communication token (fallback only)
communication_token.description: Leave empty unless the communication capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected communication MCP server, which needs no token here.

telemetry_token.title: Telemetry token (fallback only)
telemetry_token.description: Leave empty unless the telemetry capability's transport is `api`. Prefer a connected telemetry MCP server, which needs no token here.
